name: HaloPad
game: Halo: Custom Edition 1.10 (PC) and Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox)
notes: HaloPad owns padmint.json; the ios and macos targets run scripts/builder/build.sh --xbox with the player's HaloCESetup.exe and product-key.txt beside it (macos: --mac, a zipped Mac Catalyst app that needs no Apple account). The 1.10 update is downloaded by hash and applied with Wine. The Xbox edition's engine (halo-ce-universal) and ANGLE are fetched from upstream and built on the player's Mac; the player adds their own Xbox disc image in the app. The game package is handed over as HaloPad game data.

commands: brew install sevenzip winetricks llvm lld cmake ninja

game_data_import.ios: Choose Prepared Package… on HaloPad's first screen
game_data_import.macos: Choose Prepared Package… on HaloPad's first screen

steps: Install {file} on your iPhone or iPad, signed with your own Apple developer profile that allows Extended Virtual Addressing and Increased Memory Limit (the guide below shows how).
Updating? Install it over your current HaloPad with the same signing to keep your profiles and saves.

First time only: copy Halo-CE.halopad.zip from the HaloPad game data folder in {folder} to the device (Files, iCloud Drive or AirDrop). Open HaloPad: for Custom Edition tap Choose Prepared Package… and pick it; for the Xbox edition tap Add Your Xbox Disc and pick your own disc image.
Unzip {file}, move HaloPad to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account.
Updating? Replace the old HaloPad in Applications; your profiles and saves stay.

Open HaloPad. For Custom Edition (first time only): choose Choose Prepared Package… and pick Halo-CE.halopad.zip from the HaloPad game data folder in {folder}. For the Xbox edition: choose Add Your Xbox Disc and pick your own Halo: Combat Evolved disc image.

off_mac.text: PadMint builds HaloPad on a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Without one, you can still get the Xbox edition for iPhone and iPad: GitHub's free Mac runner builds it in your own copy of HaloPad's repository, then you install it with Sideloadly and add your own Xbox disc in the app. Custom Edition needs an Apple Silicon Mac.

es.text: PadMint crea HaloPad en un Mac con Apple Silicon (M1 o posterior). Sin uno, igual puedes tener la edición de Xbox para iPhone y iPad: el Mac gratuito de GitHub la crea en tu propia copia del repositorio de HaloPad; luego la instalas con Sideloadly y añades tu propio disco de Xbox en la app. Custom Edition necesita un Mac con Apple Silicon.

pt.text: O PadMint cria o HaloPad num Mac com Apple Silicon (M1 ou mais novo). Sem um, você ainda pode ter a edição de Xbox para iPhone e iPad: o Mac gratuito do GitHub a cria na sua própria cópia do repositório do HaloPad; depois você a instala com o Sideloadly e adiciona o seu próprio disco de Xbox no app. O Custom Edition precisa de um Mac com Apple Silicon.
